Can we get some “why”?  I don’t understand the motivation to use yet-another-json-library to change test cases from C++ to C. Why bother here?  Most of our C libraries use C++ for test cases. I’m not understanding the benefit specifically for libcper.
Answered in commit message.
Acknowledged
Is this a typo?  You've used it twice but then the subproject wrap file uses "libjsoncdac".  I guess the project just uses a weird naming scheme.
the project name doesn't match the lib name, it shortens daccor to dac.  Kind of annoying... but it is what it is.
Done
I guess we don't have a need for the bitbake recipe though, right?  We currently have `json-c` in the openbmc-build-scripts also, so we can add this too.
Correct, bitbake wouldn't change.
Talked with Patrick offline.
